svg.title: Draw it: one cloud, two new axes, and the bill
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the five-student cloud with its own mean marked and both new axes drawn through it at forty two point six two degrees, draw one point being squashed to a single number and rebuilt with the miss measured, and draw the thirteen explained variance shares as bars with a running total line crossing eighty percent at five components.
svg.text: Draw it: one cloud, two new axes, and the bill
1. the five-student cloud, its mean marked, BOTH new axes through it (42.62° and 132.62°)
2. one point squashed to one number and rebuilt, the miss labelled (0.2351 or 0.6183)
3. the thirteen shares as bars with a running total, 80% crossing ringed at 5
